item.title: Oil Jumps as Trump Threatens War Escalation Over Coming Weeks
item.description: Oil surged after President Donald Trump vowed an escalation to the war in Iran over coming weeks, damping hopes of a swift resolution and prolonging disruptions to energy flows through the vital Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Asian Nations Jockey for Leverage to Re-Open Strait of Hormuz
